root.label: Kimmerle Mining filed seven Bears Ears claims

events.label: Kimmerle Mining filed seven Bears Ears claims

slots.name: claims filed
slots.sentence: But the next day, the Utah-based company Kimmerle Mining filed seven mining claims in areas that were removed from Bears Ears, according to records from the San Juan County Recorder’s Office in Utah.

events.label: Craig Rosequist filed two Grand Staircase claims

slots.name: claims filed
slots.sentence: On Aug. 6, Craig Rosequist filed another two mining claims in areas that were cut from Grand Staircase, according to records from the Kane County Recorder’s Office.

events.label: At least nine claims staked on former Utah monument land

slots.name: claims staked
slots.sentence: Steve Bloch, the legal director at the Southern Utah Wilderness Alliance, a nonprofit environmental group that first noticed the nine new claims, said he worried that mining would damage the fragile desert landscape.
